title: fix(skills): enumerate every authorable top-level stack key in the platform skill, and gate it
body:
Fixes #19211

Clause-②: no

Head `d8c67e2` on base `d69f7e1` (origin/main at branch time; origin/main read as `c334ba0` for the reproduction below). Tier H: `skills/**` is on the governed register — this PR stays DRAFT; the merge is the maintainer's click.

## What changed

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (lines 72–80) — the `defineStack()` top-level key enumeration gains `packages`, `devHint`, `devLogins`, `onEnable` (40 → 44 keys; `packages` beside `manifest`, `devHint`/`devLogins` beside `devPlugins`, `onEnable` last). The lead-in "Each top-level key holds one metadata kind —" is folded into "whose top-level keys are" to pay the token ratchet: headroom was 9 tokens, the four keys cost 12; the file reads 12975 → 12981 tokens against the untouched 12984 ceiling. The trimmed clause's one-key-one-kind claim has no surviving home, deliberately: it was already false for the configuration keys (`api`, `server`, `i18n`, `onEnable`, `devHint`), and the key-to-shape pointer a reader needs is the `stack.zod.ts` paragraph directly below (lines 109–114).
- `scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` (new, 234 lines) — reads the enumeration out of the page and the keys of `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` out of `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` as SOURCE TEXT, and fails on the symmetric difference, naming each key with its direction and the contract the page states. `viewItems` and `runtimeModule` are declared machine-written, each with a witness regex re-checked against the schema source on every run (a witness that stops matching is a prerequisite failure, never a silent exclusion). Exit 0 clean · 1 drift · 2 prerequisite not met (unreadable input, absent anchor, absent table, lit-control failure, stale witness). `--skill PATH` judges another copy of the page; `--self-test` is offline, 14 cases, batteries pinned by name with a floor and the handshake flag.
- `package.json` — `check:skill-top-level-keys` (`--self-test && gate`, the sibling shape).
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — the step beside `check:skill-compatibility` in `Type Check · source gates` (no paths filter, required, so it cannot go dormant on a PR that adds a stack key without touching the skill).
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (+13) — one `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` row. Outside the claim's file surface; see Deviations.

## Mechanism assumptions — two of five corrected

1. **Confirmed.** At `d69f7e1` the enumeration lists 40 keys and none of the four. The page's contract sentence (lines 85–86) is «A phantom key like `roles:` or `policies:` is **not** a silent no-op — the top level refuses it and the stack fails to load». The gate quotes «the top level refuses it and the stack fails to load» in both drift directions, and a self-test lit control holds the live page to that sentence so the quote cannot outlive it.
2. **Refuted on the raw set.** `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` declares 46 keys and the enumeration had 40, so the symmetric difference on `origin/main` is SIX, not four. The two the card did not name: `viewItems` — typed `z.never(...)` (stack.zod.ts line 362, the machine-assembled channel; an authored value is refused with a named message) — and `runtimeModule` — `z.string().optional()` whose describe reads «Path (relative to the artifact JSON) of the compiled runtime ESM bundle. Set by `objectstack build`; do not author by hand.» (line 872; written by `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`, read by `packages/runtime/src/load-artifact-bundle.ts`, authored by nothing under `examples/`). Both are held out of the authorable set with a witness; with them held out, the difference on main is exactly the four and empty on the branch. All four named keys are top-level members of the schema shape (lines 678, 826, 850, 1448), not nested.
3. **Confirmed.** None of the four readers reconciles keys. The liveness gate's Leg 2 is the nearest shape and was not extended: it is one-directional (a member with no row), section-scoped (this section also names `roles:` and `policies:` as the phantoms the top level refuses — a section pool reads them as documented), and its extractor reads `z.enum` and literal unions, not an object literal's keys. The card wants both directions over one sentence, so a fifth reader with its own anchor.
4. **Confirmed, paid.** Headroom measured BEFORE editing: 9 tokens (12975/12984). Paid inside the same sentence as described above; no ceiling moved.
5. **Confirmed.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --test skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` → exit 3, GOVERNED (size not measured by `--test`; this diff is +275/−9). Draft stays draft.

## Four-axis analysis — why the two machine-written keys are held out rather than listed

- **实际业务需求** — measured, not read: no example app and no CLI scaffold writes `viewItems` (the schema types it `never`) or `runtimeModule` (`compile.ts` writes it into the artifact). An author-facing list that names them serves no author.
- **项目长远合理性** — the gate derives the set from the spec (spec > implementation > docs), and each exclusion is witnessed against the spec's own declaration, so the day the spec makes either key authorable the gate reds naming the stale witness instead of silently keeping the exclusion.
- **防 AI 写元数据犯错** — listing `viewItems` teaches a key the top level refuses (exactly the class-(c) trap this card is about); listing `runtimeModule` teaches hand-authoring a build output path. Held out, an AI author copying the list cannot write either.
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — no new prose, no tokens the ratchet does not have; the doc surface does not grow for keys no author writes.
- Alternative considered and declined: list both with a "machine-written" note — costs tokens the file does not have and teaches keys the page's own posture refuses. Recorded here so the maintainer can overturn it with one row deleted from `NOT_AUTHORED`.

## Reproduction (the branch's gate, two inputs)

- `git show origin/main:skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (`c334ba0`) into a scratch file, then `node scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs --skill PATH` → **exit 1**, four `[missing]` lines: `packages`, `devLogins`, `devHint`, `onEnable`; zero `[phantom]`.
- `node scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` on `d8c67e2` → **exit 0**: «enumerates all 44 authorable top-level keys of ObjectStackDefinitionSchema (2 declared machine-written and held out: viewItems, runtimeModule)».
- `--skill /nonexistent/SKILL.md` → **exit 2**, «PREREQUISITE NOT MET: cannot read the page at /nonexistent/SKILL.md (ENOENT)».
- `--self-test` → 14 cases pass, including the enumeration as published before this gate pinned as an offline fixture (exit 1 naming exactly the four).

## Gates — local, every exit captured by redirection before any pipe, tree `d8c67e2`

- Derived union (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, git-derived off the merge base): 76 commands. **69 exit 0**, **6 exit 3 NOT MEASURED** (each prints PREREQUISITE NOT MET / "NOT a pass and NOT a finding": `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:type-check-debt` — all load built `dist`; this diff touches no package, so the built tree is CI's), **1 in progress at PR-open time**: `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`. Its first run, on `2508e8c`, reddened exactly one case — «every structural read of a GOVERNED file under scripts/ is classified in GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR — unpinned: scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs::skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md» — repaired in `d8c67e2`; the re-run's verdict lands in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card. `--ran` reconciliation over the ledger: 69 run, 6 NOT-MEASURED derived from recorded exit 3, 1 unrun (that one).
- Governed prose gates the dispatch named: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` 0 · `check:pm-skill-id-lint` 0 · `check:pm-governed-prose` 0 · `check:skills-token-ratchet` 0 (12981/12984) · `check:skill-frame-sync` 0.
- Also 0: `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `@objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, `check:self-test-wired` (+ self-test), `check:self-test-workflow-commands` (+ self-test), `check:step-collectors`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:aggregator-roster`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:select-gate-families`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority` (263 swept; this gate hands out no ratchet-expanding remedy), `check:entry-guard`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:declared-population-live`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:role-word`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-widening-tells`, `check:pm-expected-skips`, `bare-root-worklist --self-test`, and the rest of the union (ledger in the report comment).
- `check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no` on the PR diff: exit 0, no tell on any of the four surfaces.
- Changeset: `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` 0 (no major bump), `check-empty-changeset.mjs` 0. Nothing published moves: no package `files[]` ships `skills/` or `scripts/` (0 hits over `packages/*/package.json`); the skill ships by catalog → `skip-changeset`.
- Pre-push: `check:commit-card-trailers` 0 on both pushes (no card relation, no model identifier in the trailer pair).

## Deviations from the claim

- **File surface +1**: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, one `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` row plus its docblock note. The `check:pm-dispatch-gates` census reds on any structural read of a governed file by a script under `scripts/` that the floor does not classify, and the new gate reads the published skill as its subject. Mechanical, same batch; `declared: false` for the same reason as the two existing undeclared rows (the path is spelled in the module body, so the derivation already matches the family for a card touching that file).
- **Gate length 234 lines against the PM's ≤ 160 figure** — header 57, code 100, self-test 77. The lines went to the binding self-test contract (batteries pinned by name, floor, handshake, the offline reproduction fixture) and the farm's conventions (exit-3 register, witnessed exclusions, `--skill` for the reproduction). Trim candidate if the seat wants one: the header's "Why" paragraph (17 lines).
- Six derived families NOT MEASURED locally (above), declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: line 486 of the same page says `objectstack.config.ts` "may export `onEnable` beside its default stack" — the named-export spelling; the schema also declares `onEnable` as a stack key and `packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts` merges the named export into the parsed stack, so both spellings are live and the section teaches one. An observation, not a defect. 承接者: none open.
- noted, not filed: `devHint` / `devLogins` have zero hits under `examples/` — no first-party app exercises them yet. 承接者: none.
- noted, not filed: `dispatch-gates.mjs` reports STALE TREE (origin/main advanced 3 commits past `d69f7e1` during this run); re-derived on `d8c67e2`, the union was unchanged except the two families this PR itself adds. 承接者: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 对外发布的 `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 里 `defineStack()` 顶层键清单补上四个已在 schema 里、运行时也兑现的键:`packages`、`devHint`、`devLogins`、`onEnable`(40 → 44)。同时新增一个门禁 `check:skill-top-level-keys`,每次 CI 都把这份清单与 `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 里 `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` 的键集双向对账:schema 有而清单没有、清单有而 schema 没有,都变红并点名。`viewItems`(schema 上是 `z.never`)和 `runtimeModule`(schema 自述「do not author by hand」)这两个机器写的键被明确排除在作者清单之外,排除条目各带一个见证正则,每次运行都回到 schema 源码核对,失效即红。

**为什么改** — 北极星第 4 条:「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」。这页同时告诉 AI 作者「顶层不认识的键会被拒绝」,却漏列了四个合法键,按它写的作者永远用不到这四个键;而且没有任何东西对账,下一次加键还会再漏。修法两半:补键 + 机械读者,和卡上建议一致。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 发布面只动了一句(该文件 token 读数 12975 → 12981,上限 12984 未动,行数 1223 不变);为付 token 棘轮,把「Each top-level key holds one metadata kind —」这半句折进「whose top-level keys are」,这半句原本对 `api`/`server`/`i18n` 等配置键就不成立,没有信息损失。门禁只读源码文本、不依赖构建,自带 14 例离线自检。回滚:revert 本 PR 即可,不涉及任何 npm 发布(`skip-changeset`:skills 按目录发布,不随 npm 版本)。若你希望把 `viewItems`/`runtimeModule` 也列进清单,删掉脚本里 `NOT_AUTHORED` 对应一行并在清单里加上即可,门禁会立刻要求两边一致。

**席位意见** — (留空,由席位定稿)

**你要做的** — 这是 Tier H 面(对外发布的 `skills/**`),PR 保持 draft;席位贴出达档复核记录后,由你点 merge。无需其他操作。
